title: Independent mechanistic investigation of BQ1–BQ7 excited-state photophysics
difficulty_reasons: The agent must formulate and discriminate physical explanations across seven molecules.
Excited-state, SOC and rate calculations require broad method planning and validation.

data.description: Self-contained BQ1–BQ7 connectivity, formulas, charge, multiplicities and solvent boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Validated per-member observables, competing hypotheses, discrimination evidence and conclusion.
